grammar_daily.topic: Yes/No questions va Wh-questions (ha/yo'q va so'roq savollari)

grammar_archive.topic: Present Simple - kundalik odatlar va faktlar uchun (I work, She studies)

parts.2: 🇬🇧 Present Simple: Darak gaplar (2/5-qism) 📌 Present Simple zamoni doimiy odatlar, takrorlanib turadigan harakatlar va umumiy faktlarni ifodalash uchun xizmat qiladi. 📝 Darak gap formulasi: • I / You / We / They + V1 (fe'lning bosh shakli) • He / She / It + V1 + (-s / -es) 🗣️ Misollar: • I work in a big company. — Men katta kompaniyada ishlayman. • She studies IT at university. — U universitetda IT sohasini o'rganadi. • We live in Tashkent. — Biz Toshkentda yashaymiz. • The sun rises in the east. — Quyosh sharqdan chiqadi. ❗ Muhim eslatma: Ega he, she, it (uchinchi shaxs birlik) bo'lganda, fe'l oxiriga albatta -s yoki -es qo'shimchasi qo'shilishini unutmang! ❌ He work every day. ✅ He works every day.
parts.3: 📌 Present Simple: Inkor gaplar (3/5) 💡 Present Simple zamonida inkor (inkor etuvchi) gap hosil qilish uchun don't (do not) va doesn't (does not) yordamchi fe'llaridan foydalanamiz. 🔤 Inkor gap formulasi: • I / You / We / They + don't + V1 (asosiy fe'l) • He / She / It + doesn't + V1 (asosiy fe'l) 📝 Misollar: • I don't work on Sundays. (Men yakshanba kunlari ishlamayman.) • She doesn't study French at school. (U maktabda fransuz tilini o'rganmaydi.) • We don't like cold weather. (Bizga sovuq ob-havo yoqmaydi.) • He doesn't watch TV in the morning. (U ertalab televizor ko'rmaydi.) ❗ Keng tarqalgan xato: Inkor gapda doesn't ishlatilganda, asosiy fe'l oxiridagi -s yoki -es qo'shimchasi tushib qoladi. Fe'l har doim lug'at shaklida yoziladi. ❌ She doesn't studies biology. ✅ She doesn't study biology.
parts.4: 📌 Present Simple: So'roq gaplar tuzilishi (4/5-qism) ❓ Present Simple zamonida so'roq gaplar tuzish uchun Do va Does yordamchi fe'llaridan foydalanamiz. 📖 So'roq gap formulalari: 🔹 Umumiy so'roq (Yes/No): Do / Does + ega + asosiy fe'l + ...? 🔹 Maxsus so'roq (Wh- questions): Wh-so'z + Do / Does + ega + asosiy fe'l + ...? 💡 Eslatma: He, She, It olmoshlari uchun Does, qolgan barcha shaxslar (I, You, We, They) uchun Do ishlatiladi. 🗣️ Misollar: • Do you work every day? (Siz har kuni ishlaysizmi?) • Does she study at university? (U universitetda o'qiydimi?) • Where do you live? (Siz qayerda yashaysiz?) • What time does he start work? (U ishni soat nechada boshlaydi?) ❗ Muhim qoida: So'roq gapda Does kelganda, asosiy fe'lga -s / -es qo'shimchasi qo'shilmaydi. Masalan: Does she studies? emas, Does she study? deb aytiladi.
parts.5: 📌 Present Simple: Amaliyot va yakuniy test (5/5-qism) 💡 Keng tarqalgan xatolar: Ushbu zamonni ishlatishda ko'pincha ikkita xatoga yo'l qo'yiladi: 1. He, she, it olmoshlaridan keyin fe'lga -s yoki -es qo'shishni unutish. Masalan, She study emas, She studies bo'lishi kerak. 2. Inkor va so'roq gaplarda does / doesn't bo'lsa ham, fe'lga yana -s qo'shish. Masalan, He doesn't works emas, He doesn't work to'g'ri bo'ladi. 📝 Bo'sh joylarni to'ldiring: 1. My brother ___ (play) football every Sunday. 2. She ___ (not / like) drinking cold coffee. 3. ___ you ___ (live) in Tashkent? 4. The sun ___ (rise) in the east. ✅ Javoblar: 1. plays — ega uchinchi shaxs birlikda (My brother = he) bo'lgani uchun fe'lga -s qo'shiladi. 2. doesn't like — she uchun inkor shaklida doesn't ishlatiladi hamda asosiy fe'ldan -s tushib qoladi. 3. Do / live — you olmoshi so'roq gapda Do yordamchi fe'li bilan qo'llanadi. 4. rises — umumiy fakt bo'lib, ega (The sun = it) birlikda bo'lgani uchun fe'lga -s qo'shiladi.

parts.1: ⏳ Third Conditional: O'tmishdagi xayoliy vaziyatlar (1/5) 📌 Third Conditional grammatikasi o'tmishda sodir bo'lgan voqea-hodisalarning aksi haqida gapirish uchun ishlatiladi. Biz ushbu qoida orqali o'tmishda o'zgarishi endi imkonsiz bo'lgan vaziyatlarni, afsuslar va pushaymonliklarni ifodalaymiz. Ya'ni, hayotda voqea allaqachon boshqacha yakunlangan, lekin biz "agar o'shanda boshqacha bo'lganida, natija ham boshqacha bo'lardi" deb xayol qilamiz. Qisqacha aytganda, bu — amalga oshmay qolgan o'tmishdagi imkoniyatlar haqidagi gaplardir. 📝 Oddiy misollar: 🔹 If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam. (Agar qattiqroq o'qiganimda, imtihondan o'tgan bo'lardim. Aslida: yaxshi o'qimadim va yiqildim.) 🔹 If they had taken a taxi, they would have arrived on time. (Agar ular taksi ushlaganlarida, o'z vaqtida yetib kelishgan bo'lardi. Aslida: taksiga o'tirishmadi va kechikishdi.) 💡 Ushbu mavzuning keyingi qismlarida biz Third Conditional qoidasining darak, inkor va so'roq gap tuzilishlarini formula hamda yangi misollar bilan bosqichma-bosqich o'rganamiz. Bizni kuzatishda davom eting!
parts.2: 📌 Third Conditional: Darak gap shakli (2/5-qism) Third Conditional orqali biz o'tmishda yuz bermagan xayoliy vaziyatlar va ularning amalga oshmagan natijalari haqida gapiramiz. Bugun ushbu grammatik qoidaning darak gap (affirmative) tuzilishini ko'rib chiqamiz. 📖 Darak gap formulasi: If + Subject + had + V3, Subject + would have + V3 (Bu yerda V3 — fe'lning o'tgan zamon sifatdoshi shakli, ya'ni Past Participle). 🗣️ Misollar: • If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam. (Agar men ko'proq o'qiganimda, imtihondan o me'yorida o'tgan bo'lardim.) • If she had woken up earlier, she would have caught the train. (Agar u vaqtliroq uyg'onganda, poyezdga ulgurgan bo'lardi.) • If we had taken a taxi, we would have arrived on time. (Agar biz taksi tutganimizda, manzilingizga o'z vaqtida yetib kelgan bo'lardik.) • If they had invited me, I would have gone to the party. (Agar ular meni taklif qilishganda, men bazmga borgan bo'lardim.) 💡 Muhim eslatma: O'zbek tiliga tarjima qilganda har ikkala qism ham "-ganda ... bo'lardi" shaklida ma'no beradi. Ogizaki nutqda had va would so'zlari ko'pincha 'd ko'rinishida qisqartiriladi. ❗ Tez-tez uchraydigan xato: Eshitilishi o'xshash bo'lsa ham, If qismida hech qachon would have ishlatilmaydi. Would have birikmasi faqat asosiy (natija) qismida keladi. ❌ Noto'g'ri: If I would have known, I would have helped. ✅ To'g'ri: If I had known, I would have helped.
parts.3: 📌 Grammar Time: Third Conditional (3/5-qism) – Inkor gaplar 💡 Inkor gap formulasi: If + Subject + hadn't + V3, Subject + wouldn't have + V3 (Vaziyatga qarab inkor inkori hadn't yoki wouldn't have orqali hosil qilinadi). 📖 Misollar: 1. If I hadn't missed the bus, I wouldn't have been late. (Agar avtobusni o'tkazib yubormaganimda, kechikmagan bo'lardim.) 2. If she had studied harder, she wouldn't have failed the exam. (Agar u yaxshiroq o'qiganda, imtihondan yiqilmagan bo'lardi.) 3. If we hadn't spent all our money, we could have bought a new car. (Agar barcha pulimizni sarflamaganimizda, yangi mashina sotib ololgan bo'lardik.) 4. If they hadn't helped us, we wouldn't have finished the project on time. (Agar ular bizga yordam bermaganida, loyihani o'z vaqtida tugatmagan bo me'mor bo'lardik.) ❗ Tez-tez uchraydigan xato: Ko'pchilik if-qismida ham wouldn't have ishlatish xatosini qiladi. Yodda tuting, If bor qismda har doim hadn't ishlatiladi. ❌ If I wouldn't have missed the bus... ✅ If I hadn't missed the bus...
parts.4: 📌 Third Conditional: So'roq gaplar (4/5-qism) 💡 Third Conditionalda so'roq gaplar o'tmishda sodir bo'lmagan voqealar va ularning xayoliy natijalari haqida so'rash uchun ishlatiladi. 📖 1. Umumiy (Yes/No) so'roq gaplar formulasi: Would + ega + have + V3 + if + ega + had + V3? (yoki: If + ega + had + V3, would + ega + have + V3?) 🔤 2. Maxsus (Wh-) so'roq gaplar formulasi: Wh-so'z + would + ega + have + V3 + if + ega + had + V3? 🗣️ Misollarni ko'rib chiqamiz: 1. Would you have passed the exam if you had studied harder? (Agar ko'proq tayyorlanganingda, imtihondan o'tgan bo'larmiding?) 2. If they had left earlier, would they have caught the train? (Agar ular barvaqtroq yo'lga chiqishganda, poyezdga yetib olgan bo'lisharmidi?) 3. What would you have done if you had missed the last bus? (Agar oxirgi avtobusga kechikkaningda, nima qilgan bo'lar eding?) 4. Where would she have gone if she had won the competition? (Agar u musobaqada g'olib chiqqanida, qayerga borgan bo'lar edi?) ❗ Muhim eslatma: So'roq shaklida ham if qismida hech qachon would ishlatilmaydi. Would yordamchi fe'li faqat asosiy natija qismida ega oldiga o'tadi.

grammar_archive.topic: Adverbs and adverbial phrases (tarz, chastota, vaqt, joy ifodalari)

parts.1: 📌 Adverbs and Adverbial Phrases — Umumiy tushuncha (1/5-qism) 📖 Ravishlar (adverbs) va ravishli iboralar (adverbial phrases) harakatning qanday, qachon, qayerda va qanday chastotada bajarilishini ifodalaydi. Ular fe'l, sifat yoki boshqa ravish ma'nosini to'ldirib, fikrimizni yanada aniq va tushunarli qilish uchun xizmat qiladi. Kundalik muloqotda voqea-hodisalarning tafsilotlarini bayon qilishda ushbu tuzilmalardan juda keng foydalanamiz. Ularsiz nutqimiz sodda va kam ma'lumotli bo'lib qoladi. 💡 Misollar: • He runs fast. — U tez yuguradi. • They live in London. — Ular Londonda yashashadi. 🔔 Eslatma: Ushbu seriyamizning keyingi qismlarida ravish va ravishli iboralarning darak, inkor hamda so'roq gaplardagi to'g'ri o'rni va tuzilish qoidalarini batafsil ko'rib chiqamiz.

grammar_archive.topic: Present Continuous (hozir davom etayotgan harakatlar uchun)

parts.1: 📌 Present Continuous zamoni: Hozir sodir bo'layotgan harakatlar (1/5-qism) 💡 Present Continuous (Hozirgi davomli zamon) aynan ayni damda, gapirayotgan momentimizda sodir bo'layotgan harakatlarni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi. Masalan, siz hozir ushbu postni o'qiyapsiz, men esa uni yozyapman. Bu zamon harakatning muayyan vaqt oralig'ida davom etayotganini va hali yakunlanmaganini ko'rsatadi. O'zbek tiliga ko'pincha fe'lga -yap qo'shimchasini qo'shish orqali tarjima qilinadi. 📖 Misollar: • I am reading an interesting book right now. (Men hozir qiziqarli kitob o'qiyapman.) • Look! It is raining outside. (Qarang! Tashqarida yomg'ir yog'yapti.) • She is speaking on the phone at the moment. (U ayni damda telefonda gaplashyapti.) 📝 Seriyamizning keyingi qismlarida ushbu zamonda darak, inkor va so'roq gap tuzilishini va ularning formulalarini birma-bir o'rganamiz. Kanalimizni kuzatib boring!
parts.2: 🇬🇧 Present Continuous: Darak gap tuzilishi (2/5) 📌 Bugun Present Continuous zamonida darak gaplar tuzish qoidasi bilan tanishamiz. Bu shakl ayni harakat sodir bo'layotgan momentni ifodalash uchun qo'llaniladi. ⚙️ Darak gap formulasi: Subject + am / is / are + Verb-ing • I + am (I'm) • He / She / It + is (He's / She's / It's) • We / You / They + are (We're / You're / They're) 🗣️ Misollar: • I am reading an interesting book right now. (Men hozir qiziqarli kitob o'qiyapman.) • She is cooking dinner in the kitchen. (U oshxonada kechki ovqat pishiryapti.) • They are playing football in the yard. (Ular hovlida futbol o'ynashyapti.) • Look! It is raining outside at the moment. (Qarang! Ayni damda tashqarida yomg'ir yog'yapti.) ❗ Keng tarqalgan xato: Ko'pincha yordamchi fe'l tushirib qoldiriladi. Masalan, "She cooking" deyish noto'g'ri. Har doim am / is / are hamda -ing qo'shimchasini birga ishlating: "She is cooking".
parts.3: 📌 Present Continuous: Inkor gaplar tuzilishi (3/5-qism) 💡 Bugun Present Continuous (hozirgi davomli zamon) iboralarida inkor gaplar (negative sentences) qanday tuzilishini ko'rib chiqamiz. 🔤 Inkor gap formulasi: Subject + am / is / are + not + Verb-ing (Qisqartirilgan shakllari: isn't / aren't. Izoh: am not birga qisqartirilmaydi). 📝 Misollar: 🔹 I am not listening to music right now. (Men hozir musiqa tinglamayapman.) 🔹 She isn't working at the moment. (U ayni damda ishlamayapti.) 🔹 They aren't playing football outside. (Ular tashqarida futbol o'ynashmayapti.) 🔹 We are not watching TV now. (Biz hozir televizor tomosha qilmayapmiz.) ❗ Muhim eslatma: Inkor shaklida ham asosiy fe me'yoriy ravishda -ing qo'shimchasi bilan ishlatiladi. "He isn't work" deyish grammatik xato hisoblanadi, to'g'ri shakli: He isn't working.
parts.4: 📌 Present Continuous: So'roq gaplar (4/5-qism) 💡 Bugun Present Continuous zamonida so'roq gaplar yasash va to'g'ri savol berish qoidalarini ko'rib chiqamiz. ❓ Umumiy savollar (Yes/No questions): Am / Is / Are + ega + fe'l-ing ...? 🔍 Maxsus savollar (Wh- questions): Wh- so'z + am / is / are + ega + fe'l-ing ...? 🗣️ Misollar: • Are you listening to music now? (Siz hozir musiqa eshityapsizmi?) • Is he sleeping in his room? (U xonasida uxlayaptimi?) • What are you cooking for dinner? (Kechki ovqatga nima pishiryapsiz?) • Where are they going right now? (Ular hozir qayerga ketishyapti?) 📝 Eslatma: So'roq gapda am, is, are yordamchi fe'llari har doim egadan oldinga o'tadi. Agar maxsus savol berilayotgan bo'lsa, what, where, why kabi so'zlar gapning eng birinchi o'rniga qo'yiladi.

grammar_archive.topic: Second Conditional (hozir yoki kelajakdagi xayoliy vaziyatlar uchun)

parts.1: 📌 Second Conditional – Xayoliy vaziyatlar (1/5-qism) 💡 Ingliz tilida Second Conditional (Ikkinchi tur shart gaplari) hozirgi yoki kelajakdagi xayoliy va real bo'lmagan vaziyatlarni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi. Bu grammatik tuzilma orqali biz "agar shunday bo'lganida, bunday bo'lardi" deb orzu-havaslarimiz yoki gipotezalarimiz haqida gapiramiz. Real hayotda ushbu vaziyatning sodir bo'lish ehtimoli juda past yoki umuman mavjud emas. Shuning uchun bu qoida nohaqiqiy shartlarni tushuntirishda eng kerakli grammatik vosita hisoblanadi. 📖 Misollar: • If I had a million dollars, I would buy a bigger house. (Agar mening bir million dollarim bo'lganida, katta uy sotib olardim.) • If she spoke French, she would move to Paris. (Agar u fransuzcha gapirganida, Parijga ko'chib o'tardi.) 📝 Keyingi qismlarda Second Conditional mavzusining darak, inkor va so'roq gap tuzilishlarini alohida va batafsil ko'rib chiqamiz. Kanalni kuzatib boring!
parts.2: 🇬🇧 Grammar Time: Second Conditional (2/5) 📌 Second Conditional – hozirgi yoki kelajakdagi nohaqiqiy, xayoliy vaziyatlarni va ularning ehtimoldan yiroq natijasini ifodalaydi. Bugun darak gap tuzilishi haqida gaplashamiz. 📐 Formula: If + Subject + Past Simple, Subject + would + V1 (Agarda "If" qismi gap oxirida kelsa, orasida vergul ishlatilmaydi). 💬 Misollar: • If I had more time, I would learn Spanish. (Agar mening ko'proq vaqtim bo'lganida, ispan tilini o'rgangan bo'lardim.) • If she lived in London, she would speak English fluently. (Agar u Londonda yashaganida, ingliz tilida ravon gapirgan bo'lardi.) • If we won the lottery, we would buy a new house. (Agar biz lotereyada yutganimizda, yangi uy sotib olgan bo'lardik.) • If I were you, I would accept this job offer. (Agar men sizning o'rningizda bo'lganimda, bu ish taklifini qabul qilgan bo'lardim.) 💡 Muhim eslatma: Nohaqiqiy vaziyatlarni ifodalashda I, he, she, it olmoshlari uchun was emas, balki were ishlatish grammatik jihatdan to'g'riroq va rasmiyroq hisoblanadi.

parts.1: 📌 Kelajak rejalar uchun: "Going to" (1/5-qism) 💡 Bugun ingliz tilida kelajakdagi rejalar va niyatlarimiz haqida gapirishni o'rganamiz. Har doim biror ishni qilishni oldindan rejalashtirgan bo'lsak va uni amalga oshirish niyatida bo'lsak, be going to iborasidan foydalanamiz. Bu ibora o'zbek tiliga ko'pincha "-moqchi bo'lmoq" yoki "-moqchiman" deb tarjima qilinadi. Misol uchun, bugun kechqurun kitob o'qimoqchi bo'lsangiz yoki dam olish kunida tog'ga bormoqchi bo'lsangiz, aynan ushbu grammatik iboradan foydalanasiz. 📖 Misollar: 🔹 I am going to buy a new car next week. (Men keyingi hafta yangi mashina sotib olmoqchiman.) 🔹 She is going to learn English this year. (U bu yil ingliz tilini o'rganmoqchi.) 🔔 Keyingi qismlarda going to iborasining darak, inkor va so'roq gaplarda yasalishi va ularning batafsil qoidalarini birma-bir ko'rib chiqamiz. Kanalimizni kuzatib boring!

grammar_archive.topic: Present Perfect (hozirgi vaqt bilan bog'liq o'tmish harakatlari uchun)

parts.1: 🇬🇧 Present Perfect zamoni: Umumiy tushuncha (1/5-qism) 📌 Present Perfect zamoni o'tmishda sodir bo'lgan, ammo natijasi va ta'siri hozirgi vaqt bilan bevosita bog'liq bo'lgan harakatlarni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi. Bu zamonda harakatning aynan qachon ro'y bergani emas, balki uning hozirgi vaqtdagi natijasi va beradigan tajribasi muhim hisoblanadi. O'zbek tiliga ko'pincha o'tgan zamon shaklida tarjima qilinsa ham, u mohiyatan hozirgi holatimizga daxldordir. 💡 Misollar: • I have lost my keys. — Men kalitlarimni yo'qotib qo'ydim. (Natijada hozir yonimda kalit yo'q va uyga kira olmayman.) • She has finished her homework. — U uy vazifasini bajarib bo'ldi. (Natijada hozir uning vazifasi tayyor va u dam olishi mumkin.) 📝 Keyingi qismlarda: Seriyamizning kelgusi qismlarida Present Perfect zamonida darak, inkor va so'roq gaplarni to'g'ri tuzish hamda uning signal so'zlarini birma-bir ko'rib chiqamiz. Kanalingizni kuzatib boring!

📌 Must va Have to: Majburiyat ifodalash (1/5-qism) 💡 Ingliz tilida biror ishni qilish shart, zarur yoki majburiy ekanligini ko'rsatish uchun asosan must va have to birikmalaridan foydalanamiz. Ikkala shakl ham o'zbek tiliga "-ishi kerak", "-ishi shart" yoki "majbur" deb tarjima qilinadi. Umuman olganda, must ko'proq so'zlovchining shaxsiy qarori va ichki hissini ifodalasa, have to esa tashqi qoidalar hamda holatlar taqozosi bilan yuzaga kelgan majburiyatni anglatadi. Ushbu umumiy qoidani to'g me'yorida tushunish ingliz tilida erkin va aniq muloqot qilishga yordam beradi. 📝 Misollar: • I must study hard for the exam. (Men imtihon uchun qattiq shug'ullanishim shart.) • You have to stop at the red light. (Siz qizil chiroqda to'xtashingiz shart.) 🔔 Keyingi qismlarda ushbu birikmalarning darak, inkor va so'roq gaplarda ishlatilish tartibini alohida-alohida batafsil ko'rib chiqamiz. Kanalimizni kuzatib boring!

grammar_archive.topic: Past Continuous (o'tmishdagi davom etayotgan harakatlar uchun)

parts.1: 📌 Past Continuous zamoni: Umumiy tushuncha (1/5-qism) 📖 Past Continuous (O'tmishdagi davomli zamon) o'tmishdagi ma'lum bir vaqtda sodir bo'layotgan va davom etayotgan harakatlarni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi. Bu zamon harakatning tugallangan natijasiga emas, balki uning o'tmishdagi jarayoniga urg'u beradi. Masalan, kecha aniq bir vaqtda nima qilayotganingizni tasvirlashda ushbu grammatik qoidadan foydalanasiz. O'zbek tiliga bu zamon ko'pincha "-yotgan edi" iborasi orqali tarjima qilinadi. 💡 Misollar: • I was reading a book yesterday at 5 PM. (Men kecha soat 5 da kitob o'qiyotgan edim.) • They were playing football all evening. (Ular butun kech bo'yi futbol o'ynayotgan edilar.) 📝 Keyingi qismlarda ushbu zamonning darak, inkor va so'roq gap shakllarini hamda maxsus kalit so'zlarini batafsil ko'rib chiqamiz. Kanallimizni kuzatib boring!
parts.2: 📚 Past Continuous zamoni: Darak gaplar (2/5) 📌 Kechagi postimizda Past Continuous zamonining umumiy ma'nosi bilan tanishgan edik. Bugun esa ushbu zamonda darak gap (affirmative sentence) tuzish qoidasini o'rganamiz. 💡 Darak gaplarning formulasi: Subject + was / were + Verb-ing 🔤 Yordamchi fe'llarning bo'linishi: • I / He / She / It — was bilan ishlatiladi. • You / We / They — were bilan ishlatiladi. 📖 Misollarni ko'rib chiqamiz: 1. I was reading a book yesterday at 5 p.m. (Men kecha soat 5 da kitob o'qiyotgan edim.) 2. They were playing football when it started to rain. (Yomg'ir yog'ishni boshlaganda, ular futbol o'ynashayotgan edi.) 3. She was cooking dinner all evening. (U butun kecha davomida kechki ovqat pishirayotgan edi.) 4. We were watching a movie at that moment. (Biz o'sha paytda kino ko'rayotgan edik.) ❗ Eslatib o'tamiz: Ingliz tilida so'zlashuvchilar orasida eng ko'p uchraydigan xato — was/were yordamchi fe'lini tushirib qoldirishdir. Masalan, "I reading a book" deyish grammatik jihatdan xato hisoblanadi. Har doim was yoki were fe'lini qo'shishni unutmang!

grammar_archive.topic: Reported speech - Statements (say va tell bilan gaplarni ko'chirish)

parts.1: 📌 Reported Speech – O'zlashtirma gaplar (1/5-qism) 📖 Muloqot davomida boshqa bir kishining aytgan gapi yoki fikrini kimgadir yetkazish uchun Reported Speech (o'zlashtirma gap) iborasidan foydalanamiz. Bu qoida kundalik so'zlashuvda, xat-xabarlarda va yangiliklarni qayta yetkazishda juda keng qo'llaniladi. Uning yordamida biz birovning so'zlarini so'zma-so me'yorida takrorlamay, mazmunini saqlagan holda atrofdagilarga aytib beramiz. O'zlashtirma gaplarni to'g me'yorida tuzish uchun, eng avvalo, say va tell fe'llarining farqini hamda zamonlar o'zgarishini tushunib olish lozim. 💬 Misollar: 🔹 Direct speech: He said, "I am ready." (U: "Men tayyorman," dedi.) 🔹 Reported speech: He said that he was ready. (U tayyor ekanligini aytdi.) 🔹 Reported speech: She told me that she lived in Tashkent. (U menga Toshkentda yashashini aytdi.) 📝 Keyingi qismlarda darak, inkor hamda so'roq gap tuzilishlarini, shuningdek, zamonlar va olmoshlarning o'zgarish qoidalarini birma-bir ko'rib chiqamiz. Bizni kuzatib boring!
parts.2: 📌 Reported Speech: Statements (say va tell) | 2/5-qism 📖 Darak gaplarni o'zlashtirma gapga o'tkazishda say va tell fe'llaridan foydalanamiz. Ularning asosiy farqi: tell fe'lidan so'ng albatta kishi (obyekt) keladi, say dan so me'yorda to'g'ridan-to'g'ri obyekt ishlatilmaydi. 🔤 Qoida va formulalar: • Subject + say + (that) + Subject + Verb (zamonda orqaga surilish) • Subject + tell + Object + (that) + Subject + Verb (zamonda orqaga surilish) 🗣️ Misollar: • Direct: "I like music," she said. Reported: She said (that) she liked music. (U musiqani yoqtirishini aytdi.) • Direct: "I am learning English," Rustam said to me. Reported: Rustam told me (that) he was learning English. (Rustam menga ingliz tilini o'rganayotganini aytdi.) • Direct: "We have finished the project," they said. Reported: They said (that) they had finished the project. (Ular loyihani yakunlashganini aytishdi.) • Direct: "I will help you," Jasur said to Nigora. Reported: Jasur told Nigora (that) he would help her. (Jasur Nigoraga unga yordam berishini aytdi.) ❗ Muhim eslatma: Tell fe'lidan keyin obyektiz gap tuzish katta xatodir! ❌ She told that she was busy. ✅ She told me that she was busy. ✅ She said that she was busy.

parts.1: 📌 First Conditional: Kelajakdagi real vaziyatlar (1/5-qism) 💡 Ingliz tilida First Conditional shartli gaplar turi bo'lib, u kelajakda yuz berishi real va ehtimoli yuqori bo'lgan voqea-hodisalarni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi. Agar ma'lum bir shart bajarilsa, uning natijasi kelajakda albatta sodir bo'ladi. Ushbu qoida kundalik hayotimizdagi rejalarni, ogohlantirishlarni yoki va'dalarni bildirishda juda keng qo'llaniladi. Shuning uchun ham bu grammatika muloqotda erkin bo'lish uchun o'ta muhimdir. 📖 Misollarni ko'rib chiqamiz: 🗣️ If it rains tomorrow, I will stay at home. (Agar ertaga yomg'ir yog'sa, men uyda qolaman.) 🗣️ If you study hard, you will pass the exam. (Agar sen qunt bilan o'qisang, imtihondan o'tasan.) 📝 Bugun ushbu grammatikaning umumiy ma'nosi va qo'llanishi bilan tanishib olgan bo'lsak, seriyamizning keyingi qismlarida First Conditional iboralarining darak, inkor va so'roq gap tuzilishlarini birma-bir ko'rib chiqamiz.
parts.2: 📌 First Conditional: Darak gaplar (2/5-qism) 💡 First Conditional kelajakdagi real va amalga oshishi mumkin bo'lgan vaziyatlarni ifodalash uchun qo'llaniladi. Bugungi darsimizda uning darak gap tuzilishini ko'rib chiqamiz. 📖 Tuzilish formulasi: If + Present Simple, Subject + will + V1 🗣️ Misollar: • If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home. (Ertaga yomg'ir yog'sa, biz uyda qolamiz.) • If you study hard, you will pass the exam. (Agar qunt bilan o'qsang, imtihondan o'tasan.) • If she arrives on time, we will start the meeting. (Agar u o'z vaqtida kelsa, biz majlisni boshlaymiz.) • They will buy a house if they save enough money. (Agar ular yetarlicha pul jamg'arishsa, uy sotib olishadi.) ❗ Muhim eslatma: If qatnashgan ergash gap qismida hech qachon will kelajak zamon fe'li ishlatilmaydi, uning o'rniga har doim Present Simple qo'yiladi. ❌ If you will work hard, you will succeed. ✅ If you work hard, you will succeed.

grammar_archive.topic: Relative clauses - Defining va Non-defining (who, which, that bilan)

parts.1: 📌 Relative Clauses: Defining va Non-defining (1/5-qism) 💡 Relative clauses (nisbiy ergash gaplar) ingliz tilida shaxs, narsa yoki joy haqida aniqroq ma'lumot berish uchun xizmat qiladi. Ular ikkita alohida gapni birlashtirib, nutqimizni yanada ravon va tabiiy qilishga yordam beradi. Bu iboralar asosan who (insonlar uchun), which (narsa-buyumlar uchun) va that (har ikkisi uchun) nisbiy olmoshlari yordamida bog'lanadi. Nisbiy ergash gaplar gap uchun ma'nosi o'ta zarur bo'lgan Defining hamda shunchaki qo'shimcha ma'lumot beruvchi Non-defining turlariga bo'linadi. 📖 Misollar: • The boy who won the race is my brother. (Poygada g'olib bo'lgan bola — mening akam.) • I lost the watch which was a gift from my friend. (Men do'stim sovg'a qilgan qo'l soatini yo'qotib qo'ydim.) 📝 Keyingi qismlarda ushbu mavzu bo'yicha darak, inkor va so'roq gap tuzilishini hamda vergullarning ishlatilish qoidalarini batafsil ko'rib chiqamiz. Bizni kuzatib boring!

grammar_archive.topic: Comparatives and Superlatives - muntazam va notartib shakllar

parts.1: 📚 Comparatives and Superlatives — Sifat darajalari (1/5-qism) 📌 Comparatives and Superlatives (Sifatning qiyosiy va orttirma darajalari) ingliz tilida shaxslar, narsalar yoki voqealarni bir-biri bilan solishtirish uchun ishlatiladi. Ikki obyektni o'zaro solishtirganimizda comparative (qiyosiy daraja), uch yoki undan ortiq obyektlar orasida eng ustunini ko'rsatmoqchi bo'lganimizda esa superlative (orttirma daraja) shaklidan foydalanamiz. Bu qoida o'z fikrimizni aniqroq, boyroq va ta'sirchanroq ifodalashga yordam beradi. Kundalik muloqotda va yozma nutqda bu mavzu eng ko'p qo'llaniladigan grammatik tuzilmalardan biridir. 📖 Misollarni ko'rib chiqamiz: • Anvar is taller than Jasur. — Anvar Jasurdan ko'ra balandbo'yliroq. • London is the biggest city in England. — London Angliyadagi eng katta shahardir. 💡 Eslatib o'tamiz: Ushbu seriyamizning keyingi qismlarida muntazam va notartib sifatlarning yasalishi hamda darak, inkor va so'roq gaplarda ishlatilish tuzilishini batafsil ko'rib chiqamiz.
parts.2: 📚 Grammar Series: Comparatives & Superlatives (2/5-qism) 📌 Darak gap qurilishi (Affirmative Structure): • Qiyosiy daraja (Comparative): Subject + verb + adj-er / more + adj + than + object • Orttirma daraja (Superlative): Subject + verb + the + adj-est / the most + adj + noun 📝 Misollar: • Regular Comparative: My new phone is faster than my old one. (Mening yangi telefonim eskisiga qaraganda tezroq.) • Regular Superlative: She is the most intelligent student in our class. (U sinfimizdagi eng aqlli o'quvchidir.) • Irregular Comparative: His English is better than mine. (Uning ingliz tili mening darajamdan ko'ra yaxshiroq.) • Irregular Superlative: This was the worst day of my life. (Bu hayotimdagi eng yomon kun edi.) ❗ Tez-tez uchraydigan xato: Bir vaqtning o'zida ham more, ham -er qo'shimchasini ishlatmang! Masalan, "more better" yoki "more taller" deyish grammatik jihatdan noto'g'ri. To'g'ri shakllar: better va taller.

grammar_archive.topic: Past Perfect (o'tmish voqealar tartibini ko'rsatish uchun)

parts.1: 📌 Past Perfect zamoni: O'tmish voqealari ketma-ketligi (1/5-qism) 📖 Past Perfect (O'tgan tugallangan zamon) o'tmishda sodir bo'lgan ikki yoki undan ortiq voqealarning sodir bo'lish tartibini ko'rsatish uchun ishlatiladi. Bu zamon o'tmishdagi biror harakat yoki vaqtdan oldinroq bajarilib bo'lingan ish-harakatni ifodalash uchun xizmat qiladi. Ya'ni, o'tmish ichidagi "eng o'tmish" harakat uchun aynan Past Perfect qo'llaniladi. Bu zamon orqali tinglovchi qaysi voqea birinchi, qaysi biri esa undan keyin yuz berganini aniq tushunib oladi. 💡 Misollar: • When I arrived at the station, the train had left. (Men vokzalga yetib kelganimda, poyezd jo'nab ketgan edi.) (Poyezd ketishi men yetib kelishimdan oldin sodir bo'lgan) • She had finished her homework before her mother came home. (Oyisi uyga kelishidan oldin u uy vazifasini bajarib bo me'yoriga yetkazgan edi.) (Vazifa bajarilishi oyisi kelishidan oldin yakunlangan) 📝 Keyingi qismlarda ushbu zamonda darak, inkor va so'roq gaplarni qanday to'g me'yorida va xatosiz tuzish qoidalarini birma-bir ko'rib chiqamiz. Kanalimizni kuzatib boring!
parts.2: ⏳ Past Perfect zamoni: Darak gaplar (2/5-qism) 📌 Darak gap formulasi: Ega + had + V3 (Past Participle) Eslatma: Ushbu zamonda barcha egalar (I, you, he, she, it, we, they) uchun bir xil had yordamchi fe'li ishlatiladi. Asosiy fe'lning 3-shakli (V3) to'g'ri fe'llarga -ed qo'shish orqali, noto'g'ri fe'llarda esa maxsus jadval bo'yicha hosil qilinadi. 📖 Misollar: 1. When I arrived at the station, the train had left. (Men vokzalga yetib kelganimda, poyezd jo'nab ketgan edi.) 2. She had finished her homework before her mother came home. (Onasi uyga kelishidan oldin u vazifasini bajarib bo'lgan edi.) 3. We had cooked dinner by the time the guests arrived. (Mehmonlar kelguniga qadar biz kechki ovqatni pishirib qo'ygan edik.) 4. They had saved enough money before they bought the car. (Moshina sotib olishdan oldin ular yetarli pul jamg'arib bo'lishgan edi.) 💡 Muhim eslatma: O'tmishda ketma-ket sodir bo'lgan ikki voqeadan birinchisiga Past Perfect, undan keyingisiga esa Past Simple ishlatiladi. Har ikkala harakat uchun ham bir vaqtda had ishlatish eng ko'p uchraydigan xatodir.

parts.1: 📌 Reported Speech - Questions: Savol gaplarni ko'chirish (1/5-qism) 💡 Kundalik muloqotda kimgadir boshqa bir inson bergan savolini yetkazib berishimizga to'g'ri keladi. Masalan, "U mendan qayerda yashashimni so'radi" kabi jumlalar ingliz tilida Reported Questions (ko'chirilgan savol gaplar) deb ataladi. To'g'ri savol gapni o'zlashtirma gapga o'tkazganimizda so'z tartibi o'zgarib, oddiy darak gap shakliga keladi hamda zamonlar bir qadam orqaga suriladi. Eng muhim qoida shundaki, ko'chirilgan savol gap oxirida so'roq belgisi qo'yilmaydi. 📝 Misollar: 🗣️ Direct: "Where do you live?" she asked. ✅ Reported: She asked me where I lived. (U mendan qayerda yashashimni so'radi.) 🗣️ Direct: "Are you a student?" he asked. ✅ Reported: He asked if I was a student. (U mendan talaba ekanligimni so'radi.) 🔔 Seriyamizning keyingi qismlarida savol gaplarning darak hamda inkor ko'rinishlari, Yes/No questions hamda Wh-questions turlarini o'zlashtirma gapga o'tkazish tartibini batafsil ko'rib chiqamiz. Kanalimizni kuzatib boring!

grammar_archive.topic: Passive voice - hozirgi va o'tmish zamonlardagi asosiy qurilmalar

parts.1: 📌 Grammar Time: Passive Voice bilan tanishamiz! (1/5-qism) 💡 Ingliz tilida Passive Voice (Majhul nisbat) harakatni kim bajarganidan ko'ra, harakatning o'zi yoki u yo'naltirilgan shaxs va buyum muhimroq bo'lganda ishlatiladi. Masalan, ishni kim qilgani noma'lum bo'lganda yoki buni ta'kidlash shart bo'lmaganda ushbu grammatik tuzilma qo'llanadi. Bu mavzu rasmiy nutq, yangiliklar va kundalik muloqotda juda ko'p uchraydi. Darslarimiz davomida Present Simple va Past Simple zamonlaridagi asosiy qurilmalarni o'rganamiz. 📖 Oddiy misollarda ko'ramiz: ✅ This book is read every day. 📝 Bu kitob har kuni o'qiladi. ✅ The window was broken yesterday. 📝 Kecha deraza sindirildi. ❗ Keyingi qismlarda ushbu zamonlarda darak, inkor va so'roq gaplarni to'g'ri yasash qoidalarini bosqichma-bosqich ko'rib chiqamiz. Bizni kuzatib boring!
parts.2: 📌 Passive Voice — Hozirgi va o'tmish zamonlarda darak gaplar (2/5) 📖 Bugungi darsimizda Present Simple hamda Past Simple zamonlarida majhul nisbatdagi darak gaplar tuzilishini o'rganamiz. ⚡ Present Simple Passive formulasi: Subject + am / is / are + V3 (Past Participle) ⏳ Past Simple Passive formulasi: Subject + was / were + V3 (Past Participle) 📝 Darak gaplarga misollar: 🔤 English is spoken all over the world. Ingliz tili butun dunyoda gapiriladi. 🔤 Fresh bread is baked every morning. Har kuni ertalab yangi non yopiladi. 🔤 This historic bridge was built in 1920. Bu tarixiy ko'prik 1920-yilda qurilgan. 🔤 Important letters were sent yesterday. Muhim xatlar kecha yuborildi. ❗ Ko'p uchraydigan xato: Fe'lning oddiy o'tgan zamon shakli (V2) bilan Past Participle (V3) shaklini adashtirib qo'ymang. Masalan, "The letter was wrote" deyish xatodir, to'g'ri shakli — "The letter was written" bo'ladi.
parts.3: 📌 Passive Voice — Inkor shakllari (3/5-qism) 💡 Majhul nisbatda (Passive Voice) inkor gap tuzish uchun yordamchi fe'llardan (am / is / are yoki was / were) so'ng not inkor yuklamasi qo'shiladi. ⚙️ Hozirgi zamon (Present Simple Passive): Subject + am / is / are + not + V3 (yoki isn't / aren't) ⚙️ O'tmish zamon (Past Simple Passive): Subject + was / were + not + V3 (yoki wasn't / weren't) 📝 Misollarni o'rganamiz: 🔹 The report is not written in English. (Hisobot ingliz tilida yozilmagan.) 🔹 These offices are not cleaned on Sundays. (Bu idoralar yakshanba kunlari tozalanmaydi.) 🔹 The car was not repaired yesterday. (Mashina kecha ta'mirlanmadi.) 🔹 The documents were not sent on time. (Hujjatlar o'z vaqtida yuborilmadi.) ❗ Keng tarqalgan xato: Majhul nisbat inkorida don't / doesn't yoki didn't so'zlarini ishlatmang! Masalan, The car didn't repaired deyish xato. To'g'ri shakli: The car was not repaired.

parts.1: 📌 Should modal fe'li: Maslahat berish (1/5-qism) 💡 Ingliz tilida biror kishiga maslahat berish, to'g'ri va ma'qul taklif bildirish uchun should modal fe'lidan foydalanamiz. Bu so'z o'zbek tiliga ko'pincha "-ishi kerak" yoki "-sa yaxshi bo'lardi" deb tarjima qilinadi. Biz should yordamida birovga majburiy buyruq bermaymiz, balki do'stona va xushmuomala tarzda o'z fikrimizni bildiramiz. Masalan, do'stingiz charchagan bo'lsa yoki tishi og'riyotgan bo'lsa, unga nima qilish ma'qulligini ko'rsatishda ushbu qoida juda qo'l keladi. 📖 Misollar: 🗣️ You should sleep early tonight. (Siz bugun tunda vaqliroq uxlashingiz kerak.) 🗣️ We should drink more water every day. (Biz har kuni ko'proq suv ichishimiz kerak.) 📝 Keyingi qismlarda should ishtirokida darak, inkor va so'roq gaplar tuzilishini batafsil ko'rib chiqamiz. Biz bilan birga o'rganishda davom eting!
parts.2: 📌 Grammar: Should (Maslahat berish) — 2/5-qism 💡 Bugungi darsimizda Should modal fe'li yordamida darak gaplar tuzishni o'rganamiz. Bu shakl kimgadir foydali maslahat berish yoki to'g'ri tavsiya bildirish uchun qo'llaniladi. 📖 Darak gap formulasi: Subject + should + Verb 1 🗣️ Misollar: • You should drink more water every day. (Siz har kuni ko'proq suv ichishingiz kerak.) • He should see a doctor as soon as possible. (U imkon qadar tezroq shifokorga ko'rinishi kerak.) • We should learn new English words daily. (Biz har kuni yangi inglizcha so'zlarni o'rganishimiz kerak.) • They should rest after a long journey. (Ular uzoq yo'ldan keyin dam olishlari kerak.) ❗ Muhim eslatma: Should modal fe'lidan so'ng keladigan asosiy fe'l oldidan to yuklamasi ishlatilmaydi. Shuningdek, ega (he, she, it) o'zgarsa ham, fe'lga hech qanday qo'shimcha (masalan, -s yoki -ed) qo'shilmaydi. ❌ Noto'g'ri: She should to go / He should goes. ✅ To'g'ri: She should go / He should go.

parts.1: 📌 Grammar: May va Might (Ehtimollik) — 1/5-qism 💡 Bugun ingliz tilida biror voqea yoki hodisaning sodir bo'lish ehtimolligini ifodalashni o'rganamiz. Kundalik hayotda "Ahmad kelib qolishi mumkin" yoki "Bugun yomg'ir yog'sa kerak" kabi gaplarni ko'p ishlatamiz. Ingliz tilida bunday noma'lum holatlar uchun may va might modalli fe'llari qo'llaniladi. Har ikkala fe'l ham hozirgi yoki kelajakdagi taxminlarni bildiradi, biroq might ishlatilganda ehtimollik darajasi mayga nisbatan biroz pastroq bo'ladi. 📖 Misollar: 🔹 It may rain this afternoon. (Bugun tushdan keyin yomg'ir yog'ishi mumkin.) 🔹 She might be at home now. (U hozir uyda bo'lishi mumkin.) 📝 Bu ushbu mavzu bo'yicha kirish qismi edi. Keyingi postlarda may va might fe'llari yordamida darak, inkor hamda so'roq gaplar tuzish qoidalarini alohida va batafsil o'rganamiz. Kanaldan uzoqlashmang!

grammar_archive.topic: Yes/No questions va Wh-questions (ha/yo'q va so'roq savollari)

parts.1: 🇬🇧 Yes/No va Wh-questions: Umumiy tushuncha (1/5-qism) 📌 Ingliz tilida muloqot qilishning eng muhim qismi — to'g'ri savol berish ko'nikmasidir. Savollar mazmunan ikkita katta guruhga bo'linadi: Yes/No questions (Ha/Yo'q savollari) va Wh-questions (Maxsus savollar). Birinchi turdagi savollarga faqat "ha" yoki "yo'q" deb javob berish yetarli bo'ladi. Ikkinchi turdagilar esa What, Where, When kabi so'roq so'zlari bilan boshlanib, suhbatdoshdan aniq ma'lumot olish uchun ishlatiladi. 💡 Misollar: • Do you speak English? — Siz ingliz tilida gapirasizmi? (Yes/No question) • Where do you live? — Siz qayerda yashaysiz? (Wh-question) 📝 Seriyamizning keyingi qismlarida ushbu savollarning darak, inkor va so me'yoriy shakllanishi hamda turli zamonlardagi formulalarini atroflicha ko'rib chiqamiz. Kanalni kuzatib boring!
